purpose: Test numerical endpoint stability of the completed-U1 production path over a prospectively fixed finite short interval after the certified one-step entry gate C10.65s2k. This is a multi-accepted-step endpoint test, not a full-history or cosmological stability theorem.

constraint_policy.rationale: The bound is frozen before s3a execution. It is roughly sixty times above a deliberately conservative linear scaling of the s2k one-step roundoff-level momentum drift across the interval/retry-width ratio, while remaining a stringent numerical constraint criterion.

interpretation_if_pass: On the same one-point x four-anchor low-k domain, the completed-U1 production path remains finite and constraint-consistent at the endpoint of a 1e-6 Mpc multi-step interval under the unchanged pinned adaptive RK tolerance. This is a scoped numerical endpoint-stability certificate only, not a full-trajectory or cosmological stability theorem.
next_if_pass: Freeze a path-sampled short-interval gate that observes constraints at accepted intermediate states, or widen the endpoint interval in a separately preregistered sequence before any spectra calculation.
